title: Axo connections and the relay transport they need (RFD0016)

TransportFragment.description: One piece of a relay message larger than one 64 KiB frame. The receiver joins the base64-decoded `data` of fragments 0 to count - 1 and parses the result as one message. Every fragment but the last carries exactly 46080 bytes; a reassembled message is at most 2 MiB; at most 4 may be partly received per socket.
